title: Kiln's graphics tools now (<game>/kiln/state/graphics.json), format 1
description: What Kiln's graphics tools do in the game client (docs/kiln/graphics.md): the upscaler behind the game's FSR 3 option (what the player chose, what runs, why the choice does not), the vendor files Kiln found in kiln/vendor/, the frame cap and the DLSS settings. Written by Kiln.Ui (managed/services/Kiln.Ui/UiUpscaler.cs, GraphicsStateFile) at start and, checked every 2 seconds, again only when something in it changed (frame rates are left out); atomically (a temporary file, then a rename). Reader: the launcher (Settings, Graphics; GameStatus.graphicsState): 'Now' while the process that wrote it runs (kiln_manage::launch::state_file_is_current), 'Last game' after. A client only.

pid.description: The game's process id as the game sees it (under Proton, the Windows pid: the launcher compares the file's write time with the process's start).

kiln.description: Kiln version of the runtime that wrote it.

running.description: What upscales behind the game's FSR 3 option now (kiln_ui.h KILN_UI_UPSCALE_RUN_*). off: Kiln's swap is not in (the game's own chosen, or see reason). notFsr: the swap is in but the game did not upscale with FSR 3 in the last two seconds (FSR 3 not chosen in the game's settings, or no world). unknown: a kiln-ui.dll without the phase B status.

reason.description: Why the chosen upscaler does not run, null when it runs or the game's own is chosen (kiln_ui.h KILN_UI_UPSCALE_WHY_* in camelCase; texts: docs/kiln/graphics.md). Known codes: restart, filesMissing, filesBad, loadFailed, device, createFailed, runtimeFailed, fault, aside, noSignatures, inputs, unavailable, waiting, noVulkan; unknown (with reasonNumber) for a number this Kiln.Ui has no name for. Later versions add codes: show a code you do not know as unknown.

version.description: The version that runs (FSR 4.1.2, FSR 3.1.6, XeSS 3.0.2); absent for the game's FSR 3 or nothing.

hooked.description: Kiln's hooks on the game's FSR 3 pass are in (KILN_UI_UPSCALE_HOOKED).

fsrSeen.description: The game upscaled with FSR 3 in the last two seconds.

filesOk.description: The chosen upscaler's files are there and match their pinned SHA-256.

deviceOk.description: The game's Vulkan device has what the chosen upscaler needs.

fellBack.description: The chosen upscaler failed in this session: the game's FSR 3 until a restart.

amdPinned.description: AMD FSR 3.1 runs because the player pinned it (FSR 4 would run).

aside.description: The tools Kiln's upscaler steps aside for.

detail.description: kiln.ui's English detail of the reason (a file's or a Vulkan extension's name, a fault), for tooltips and support.

files.description: Per vendor folder (amd, intel): this runtime's version of its files and what of them is in kiln/vendor/<vendor>/<version>/, by name and size, with the launcher's receipt (present: all of them and the receipt; the game checks the SHA-256 before it loads them).

active.description: The cap paces the game's frames now.
The game upscaled with DLSS in the last two seconds.

restart.description: A DLSS setting is on now but was not at start: it applies from the next start.

preset.description: The render preset asked for: default, or a letter (A..O); unknown for a value without a letter.
